:::{#exr-full-column-rank-practice}
#### Testing whether an all-ones column and one feature have full column rank

Regression software often puts an all-ones [column](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix-column) in the input [matrix](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix),
beside the features.
With one feature, measured at $2$, $4$ and $6$,
the input matrix is

$$
\matr{X} = \sbmat{1 & 2 \\ 1 & 4 \\ 1 & 6}.
$$

Does $\matr{X}$ have [full column rank](#def-full-column-rank)?

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

By @def-full-column-rank,
check whether the two [columns of $\matr{X}$](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix-column) are [linearly independent](#def-linearly-independent).

:::

:::
